tools.name: assess_property_photo
tools.description: Assesses a photo of something in a building — an appliance, a boiler, a pipe, a water heater, an electrical panel, a fitting, a leak, damage — and reports what it is, how urgent it is and which trade it needs. Returns the fixed contract: what the asset is, whether a fault is visible, one of four urg

tools.name: get_triage_profile
tools.description: Returns a saved fixRAgent assessment by its diagnosis_id (from an assessment, the last part of a fixragent.com/c/<id> link, or the h- code that comes with a fixragent.com photo link once the photo has been added there; with no photo added yet, it reports that there is no result). Read only: it never

tools.name: try_sample
tools.description: Returns a stored fixRAgent assessment of a sample photo from fixRAgent's test set (an HVAC air handler and furnace), labelled SAMPLE, plus how to get a free key. Needs no key and no input, reads no photo and spends nothing. The result is a sample, not an assessment of anyone's own photo.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assess_property_photo" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
